subject: Pipeline: Fleet sprint snapshot & capacity ask (Orion AI pilot)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Orion pilot - initial capacity ask & pipeline snapshot

Team — quick summary from the discovery call with Orion this morning and a small capacity ask heading into next sprint. Included the pipeline sheet as an attachment.

TL;DR:
- Orion intends to start a 6-week pilot in mid-June.
- Forecasted peak: ~2M generated tokens/day (Q3 pilot peak).
- Primary workload: low-latency chat + embeddings for search.
- They want performance equivalent to 4x A100-style GPUs for steady-state with headroom for bursts.

Ask:
1) Infra: can we provision four dedicated slots (or equivalent) starting 2027-06-10 for pilot window, with ability to burst to +50% on demand?
2) Finance: we need a quick sensitivity on committed vs. on-demand pricing impact if we reserve for 3 vs 12 months.
3) Sales: I'll own the POC but need the mutual action plan to include clear capacity SLAs and fallback model variants.

Notes:
- Attachment: orion_pipeline_v2.xlsx (contains ARR estimate, expected token curves by week).
- They mentioned potential marketplace procurement via CloudScale — CC'd procurement contact below.

Next step: can we get a short-capacity sketch by EOD Tuesday so I can set expectations with Orion?

Thanks,
Ben
--
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-26T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orion pilot - initial capacity ask & pipeline snapshot

On Mon, Apr 25, 2027 at 09:12 AM Ben Carter wrote:
> Team — quick summary from the discovery call with Orion this morning and a small capacity ask heading into next sprint. Included the pipeline sheet as an attachment.

Thanks for the context, Ben. Short response and a pragmatic sizing proposal.

Reality check:
- 2M tokens/day ~ steady-state 0.8k tokens/sec sustained with spiky tails. Latency requirement (sub-100ms per token) drives GPU choice.
- Four A100-equivalent GPUs reserved for 6-week pilot is reasonable if they need dedicated KV cache per tenant and strict isolation.

Recommendations (two paths):
A) Dedicated-reserve path (preferred for SLA):
  - 4x A100-equivalent dedicated slots, pinned to the pilot from 2027-06-10 to 2027-07-22.
  - Configure auto-burst pool with 2 additional burst slots (pay-as-you-go) capped at 50% of reserved.
  - Enable prefix caching for embeddings to reduce token cost on steady queries.
  - Quantization: recommend q8_0 for initial pilot to keep latency tight; switch to q4 for cost trials if they accept slight latency increase.

B) Hybrid path (cost-lean):
  - 2 dedicated slots + autoscale to 6 using marketplace/dedicated mix when load spikes.
  - Leverage model variants (smaller decoder) for non-critical workloads.

Operational asks for Sales/Finance:
- Need a confirmed pilot start date and minimum guaranteed daily tokens (or a committed baseline) to justify Reserve path.
- If they commit to 12 months, we should size reserve up (7-8 slots) and offer stronger unit pricing.

I've attached a quick sizing matrix: gpu_sizing_matrix.csv. It shows latency vs tokens/sec for our common model families and the expected slot counts per approach.

If you want, I can sketch the canary/rollout plan for the pilot (model fallback, region routing) for the huddle.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-27T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orion pilot - initial capacity ask & pipeline snapshot

Thanks — useful framing. A couple quick finance clarifications before we sign off on any reserve commitments: 

1) Commitment horizon impact:
   - 3-month reserved commitment: unit cost ~ +25% vs 12-month reserve in our internal model (higher ops friction, lower amortization).
   - 12-month reserved commitment: significant unit discount, but we need revenue visibility (commit or strong MQL).

2) Minimum baseline:
   - For a reserved size of 4 GPUs, we want a minimum committed baseline of 1.2M tokens/day or a minimum monthly $ commit of $XXk to protect margins.

3) Contract mechanics:
   - If CloudScale procurement is used, add ~3 business days extra for PO processing and procurement checks.

Action for Sales: can you confirm whether Orion is prepared to sign a 3- or 12-month reservation amendment? Also please provide the HubSpot deal id and the estimated ramp week-by-week (Ben's sheet helps).

I'll run a quick delta on unit economics for the two commitment lengths and share before the weekly huddle.

Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Finance — Commercial
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Orion pilot - initial capacity ask & pipeline snapshot

Great thread — thanks everyone for rapid input. Consolidating and proposing next steps so the team has a single source of truth ahead of Friday's pilot kickoff planning.

Planned short plan / agenda for this week's cross-functional huddle (2027-04-30 10:00 PT — meets at https://meet.example/laura-weekly-fleet):
1) Confirm Orion pilot start date and signed MOU / commitment horizon. (Owner: Ben)
2) Choose capacity path (Dedicated-reserve vs Hybrid). Present Karthik's latency/cost tradeoffs. (Owner: Karthik)
3) Finance delta and recommended pricing bands for 3 vs 12 months (Owner: Mina)
4) Procurement timeline if CloudScale proc is used (Owner: Jordan)
5) Operational runbook: canaries, fallback model variants, and burst policies (Owner: Karthik / Ops)

Action items (owners and due dates):
- Ben: confirm HubSpot deal id and updated weekly ramp table (due 2027-04-30 09:00 PT). Attachment referenced: orion_pipeline_v2.xlsx.
- Karthik: publish a short two-slide note with the sizing matrix (gpu_sizing_matrix.csv) and the recommended initial config for the pilot (due 2027-04-30 09:00 PT).
- Mina: share economics delta (3 vs 12 months) before the huddle (due 2027-04-30 09:00 PT).
- Jordan: confirm procurement PO timeline for CloudScale channel (due 2027-04-30 EOD).

Attachments I uploaded to the shared Drive and included in this thread: weekly-huddle-agenda.pdf, orion_pipeline_v2.xlsx (Ben's sheet), gpu_sizing_matrix.csv (Karthik). Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c_orion_pipeline_v2

If we can lock the commitment horizon in this huddle, infra can prepare the dedicated slot reservation template and ops can prepare the runbook. If not, we'll proceed with the Hybrid path and a tighter canary.

Thanks — see you all tomorrow.

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Operations, Redwood Inference
